1793889229406.Text: A conversão de estímulos sensoriais em sinais elétricos chama-se {{c1::transdução}}.
1793889229406.Extra: Receptors convert stimulus energy into a change in membrane potential. Sensory neurons then carry the information toward integrating circuits.

1793889229407.Text:
Arco reflexo, do estímulo à resposta:
Entrada no centro: via {{c1::aferente}}
Saída do centro: via {{c1::eferente}}
1793889229407.Extra: Receptors detect a stimulus, central circuits integrate the input, and efferent neurons activate an effector. Interneurons can link sensory input to motor output.

1793889229408.Text: Em arcos reflexos, {{c1::interneurônios}} conectam vias sensitivas a {{c2::motoneurônios}}.
1793889229408.Extra: Interneurons integrate sensory input and influence motor output. Polysynaptic reflexes include such a relay, whereas a monosynaptic sensory-to-motor connection does not require an interneuron.

1793889229409.Text: Na neurulação, a {{c2::notocorda}} induz o ectoderma sobrejacente a formar a {{c1::placa neural}}.
1793889229409.Extra: Induction converts surface ectoderm into neuroectoderm. The neural plate folds before the neural tube separates from the surface.

1793889229410.Text: Na neurulação, as {{c2::pregas neurais}} fundem-se na linha mediana para formar o {{c1::tubo neural}}.
1793889229410.Extra: Closure encloses a lumen while the surrounding surface ectoderm separates. The tube develops into the brain and spinal cord.

1793889229411.Text: No desenvolvimento nervoso, a crista neural origina componentes do sistema {{c1::periférico}}, e o tubo neural, do {{c1::central}}.
1793889229411.Extra: Neural crest cells migrate away from the closing tube. CNS neurons and macroglia arise from neuroectoderm; microglia have a different embryonic origin.

1793889229412.Text: No desenvolvimento encefálico, o {{c3::prosencéfalo}} origina o {{c1::telencéfalo}} e o {{c2::diencéfalo}}.
1793889229412.Extra: Expansion of the telencephalic vesicles forms the cerebral hemispheres. The diencephalon remains around the third ventricle.

1793889229413.Text: No desenvolvimento encefálico, a vesícula {{c2::média}} mantém-se como {{c1::mesencéfalo}}.
1793889229413.Extra: Unlike the forebrain and hindbrain, the midbrain does not split into two secondary vesicles. Its narrow cavity becomes the cerebral aqueduct.

1793889229414.Extra: The two hindbrain divisions form different adult structures. The metencephalon gives rise to pons and cerebellum, while the myelencephalon forms the medulla.

1793889229415.Text: O metencéfalo embrionário origina a {{c1::ponte}} e o {{c1::cerebelo}} no adulto.
1793889229415.Extra: A common embryonic origin explains why both structures belong to the hindbrain, although they have different adult shapes and connections.

1793889229416.Text: O mielencéfalo embrionário origina o {{c1::bulbo}} no adulto.
1793889229416.Extra: The medulla is the caudal part of the brainstem and continues into the spinal cord. It develops below the pontine region.

1793889229417.Text: Os prolongamentos especializados em receber sinais de outros neurônios são os {{c1::dendritos}}.
1793889229417.Extra: Branching expands the receptive surface. Synaptic inputs on dendrites and soma influence whether the neuron generates an action potential.

1793889229418.Text: O prolongamento especializado em conduzir a saída do neurônio para outras células é o {{c1::axônio}}.
1793889229418.Extra: Action potentials travel along the axon to terminal regions, where communication with another neuron or an effector occurs.

1793889229419.Text: O centro metabólico do neurônio, com núcleo e organelas de síntese, é o {{c1::corpo celular}}.
1793889229419.Extra: The soma synthesizes proteins required by the neuron. Axonal transport distributes materials to distant portions of its processes.

1793889229420.Text: Após lesão nervosa, {{c2::astrócitos}} participam da formação de {{c1::cicatriz glial}}.
1793889229420.Extra: Reactive astrocytes change their processes and help contain damaged tissue. This response does not replace lost neurons with functionally equivalent neurons.

1793889229421.Text: A homeostase extracelular depende da captação de {{c2::potássio}} por {{c1::astrócitos}}.
1793889229421.Extra: Extracellular potassium rises during neuronal activity. Buffering limits disturbances in membrane excitability and supports continued signaling.

1793889229422.Text: A glia que remove o excesso de neurotransmissores ao redor das sinapses é o {{c1::astrócito}}.
1793889229422.Extra: Uptake helps terminate signaling and controls extracellular glutamate. This prevents sustained receptor activation and excitotoxic stress.

1793889229423.Text: {{c2::Oligodendrócitos}} formam a bainha de mielina no sistema nervoso {{c1::central}}.
1793889229423.Extra: Oligodendrocyte processes wrap CNS axons. Myelin insulates internodes and supports rapid saltatory conduction.

1793889229424.Text: Um oligodendrócito pode mielinizar segmentos de {{c1::vários axônios}}.
1793889229424.Extra: Separate processes from one oligodendrocyte can form internodes on different CNS axons. A myelinating Schwann cell instead forms one internode on one axon.

1793889229425.Text: {{c2::Células de Schwann}} formam a bainha de mielina no sistema nervoso {{c1::periférico}}.
1793889229425.Extra: Myelinating Schwann cells wrap peripheral axons. Their internodes alternate with nodes of Ranvier, where action potentials regenerate.

1793889229426.Text: Uma célula de Schwann mielinizante forma {{c1::um internódulo}} de um único axônio.
1793889229426.Extra: A long myelinated peripheral axon requires many Schwann cells in series. Nonmyelinating Schwann cells can ensheath multiple small axons without forming myelin.

1793889229427.Text: A glia fagocitária residente no sistema nervoso central é a {{c1::micróglia}}.
1793889229427.Extra: Microglia clear debris and respond to tissue injury. Resident microglia arise from embryonic yolk sac macrophage precursors, rather than requiring continuous replacement by blood monocytes.

1793889229428.Text: Na forma desmielinizante de Guillain–Barré, a mielina afetada é produzida por {{c1::células de Schwann}}.
1793889229428.Extra: This is a peripheral demyelinating process, in contrast to central demyelination in multiple sclerosis. Axonal variants of Guillain–Barré syndrome also exist.

1793889229429.Text: A esclerose múltipla envolve destruição {{c2::autoimune}} da mielina central e lesão de {{c1::oligodendrócitos}}.
1793889229429.Extra: Loss of CNS myelin slows or blocks conduction. The affected region determines the deficit; this contrasts with peripheral demyelination.

1793889229430.Text: Os astrócitos relacionam-se com os capilares da barreira hematoencefálica por {{c1::prolongamentos podais}}.
1793889229430.Extra: Astrocytic endfeet surround CNS microvessels and support barrier function. Endothelial tight junctions provide the principal physical seal; astrocytes regulate its maintenance rather than forming that seal themselves.

1793889229431.Text: As células não neuronais de sustentação, isolamento e defesa do tecido nervoso constituem a {{c1::glia}}.
1793889229431.Extra: Different glial cells perform distinct support functions. Astrocytes regulate the local environment, oligodendrocytes form CNS myelin, and microglia provide resident immune surveillance.

1793889229432.Text: O filamento intermediário usado como marcador de astrócitos é {{c1::GFAP}}.
1793889229432.Extra: Glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) is an intermediate filament protein used to identify astrocytic differentiation. It is a cell marker, rather than the molecule responsible for myelin insulation.

1793889229433.Text: Na sinapse {{c1::química}}, a comunicação entre células depende de {{c2::neurotransmissores}}.
1793889229433.Extra: The transmitter crosses an extracellular cleft and binds postsynaptic receptors. The response can increase or decrease the likelihood of firing.

1793889229434.Text: Na sinapse {{c2::elétrica}}, as células comunicam-se diretamente por {{c1::junções comunicantes}}.
1793889229434.Extra: Gap junction channels allow ionic current to pass between cells. Direct coupling supports rapid transmission and synchronization.

1793889229435.Text: Na sinapse química, o {{c3::potencial de ação}} abre {{c4::canais de cálcio}} no terminal {{c2::pré-sináptico}}, liberando {{c1::neurotransmissores}}.
1793889229435.Extra: Calcium entry triggers vesicle fusion. Released transmitter binds postsynaptic receptors; the resulting potential is not necessarily sufficient to trigger another action potential.

1793889229436.Text: Em axônios mielinizados, os nós de {{c2::Ranvier}} permitem condução {{c1::saltatória}}.
1793889229436.Extra: Myelin limits current loss between nodes. Action potentials regenerate at the nodes rather than continuously along every internodal segment.

1793889229437.Text: Os nós de Ranvier concentram canais de {{c1::sódio}} dependentes de voltagem.
1793889229437.Extra: High channel density permits rapid regeneration of the action potential. Insulated internodes carry local current to the next node.

1793889229438.Text: A propriocepção muscular é conduzida por fibras do grupo {{c1::I}}, equivalentes às Aα.
1793889229438.Extra: Group I fibers include Ia and Ib afferents. Their large diameter and heavy myelination support rapid feedback about muscle length and tension.

1793889229439.Text: As fibras do grupo II associadas ao tato correspondem às fibras {{c1::Aβ}}.
1793889229439.Extra: These myelinated afferents conduct mechanosensory information rapidly. Their diameter is smaller than that of the largest group I afferents.

1793889229440.Text: A dor aguda e o frio são conduzidos por fibras {{c1::III e Aδ}}.
1793889229440.Extra: Group III and Aδ are two names for thinly myelinated sensory fibers. Their conduction is slower than that of the larger group I and II fibers.

1793889229441.Text: A dor surda e o calor são conduzidos por fibras {{c1::IV e C}}.
1793889229441.Extra: Group IV and C refer to small unmyelinated sensory axons. Their slow conduction contrasts with the thinly myelinated Aδ fibers that carry fast sharp pain.

1793889229442.Text: A dor rápida segue por fibras {{c1::Aδ}}, enquanto a dor lenta segue por {{c1::C}}.
1793889229442.Extra: Aδ fibers are thinly myelinated, whereas C fibers lack myelin. Their different conduction velocities help explain the two temporal components of nociception.

1793889229443.Text: As fibras nervosas mais finas e amielínicas pertencem ao grupo {{c1::C}}.
1793889229443.Extra: Small diameter raises axial resistance, and absent myelin prevents saltatory conduction. These features account for slow conduction compared with myelinated fibers.

1793889229444.Text:
Neurônios por prolongamentos:
Vários dendritos e um axônio: {{c1::multipolar::m…}}
Um dendrito e um axônio: {{c1::bipolar::b…}}
Um prolongamento bifurcado: {{c1::pseudounipolar::p…}}
1793889229444.Extra: Morphology reflects the arrangement of receiving and conducting processes. In a pseudounipolar sensory neuron, both branches have axonal structure and the soma lies off the main conduction path.

1793889229445.Text: Nos neurônios pseudounipolares, o sinal passa do ramo periférico ao central sem atravessar o {{c1::corpo celular}}.
1793889229445.Extra: The soma lies off the main conduction path. Both branches have axonal structure, so a sensory impulse can continue directly from the peripheral process into the central process.

1793889229446.Extra: Cranial nerves connect with the brain, while spinal nerves connect with the spinal cord. The two counts refer to different anatomical groups.

1793889229447.Extra: Nerves bundle axons, ganglia contain neuronal somata, and endings connect neural signals with receptors or effectors. This classification uses anatomy, rather than the direction of information flow.

1793889229448.Text:
Divisão funcional do sistema nervoso:
Relação com corpo e meio externo: {{c1::somático}}
Relação com vísceras e meio interno: {{c1::visceral}}
1793889229448.Extra: Both domains include sensory input and motor output. Somatic motor output supplies skeletal muscle; visceral motor output is autonomic and supplies smooth muscle, cardiac muscle and glands.

1793889229449.Text: Os ramos posteriores dos nervos espinais contêm fibras {{c1::aferentes e eferentes}}.
1793889229449.Extra: Ventral rami are also mixed. Roots separate sensory input from motor output before they unite; rami distribute the already mixed spinal nerve.

1793889229450.Extra: The cerebellum lies dorsal to the brainstem. Its position distinguishes it from the cerebrum and from the three brainstem divisions.

1793889229451.Extra: Lipid-rich myelin gives this tissue its pale appearance. Axonal bundles link gray matter regions within the CNS.

1793889229452.Extra: Gray matter contains neuronal somata, dendrites, synapses, glia and axons. It forms superficial cortex and deep nuclei, rather than being limited to the brain surface.

1793889229453.Text: A substância cinzenta encefálica forma {{c1::córtex}} na superfície e {{c1::núcleos}} em profundidade.
1793889229453.Extra: Gray matter is not confined to the brain surface. Deep nuclei contain neuronal somata and local circuits within regions surrounded by white matter.

1793889229454.Text:
Agregados de corpos neuronais:
No sistema central: {{c1::núcleos}}
No sistema periférico: {{c1::gânglios}}
1793889229454.Extra: The terms distinguish anatomical location. The traditional expression basal ganglia refers to deep CNS nuclei and is a naming exception, not evidence that those structures are peripheral.

1793889229455.Text: A dilatação medular ligada à inervação dos membros superiores é a {{c1::intumescência cervical}}.
1793889229455.Extra: Upper limb innervation requires larger populations of motor neurons and local sensory circuits. The enlargement corresponds to the roots supplying the brachial plexus.

1793889229456.Text: A dilatação medular ligada à inervação dos membros inferiores é a {{c1::intumescência lombossacral}}.
1793889229456.Extra: Lower limb innervation requires larger populations of motor neurons and local sensory circuits. The enlargement corresponds to roots supplying the lumbosacral plexus; its function differs from the cervical enlargement.

1793889229457.Text: No corno anterior, motoneurônios para músculos {{c2::distais}} ficam mais {{c1::lateralmente}}.
1793889229457.Extra: Medial motor pools supply axial and proximal muscles. This mediolateral organization links the location of motor neuron groups to the body region they control.

1793889229458.Text: No corno anterior, motoneurônios para {{c2::extensores}} ficam mais {{c1::ventralmente}}.
1793889229458.Extra: Flexor motor pools lie more dorsally within the anterior horn. Both groups are motor; this is not the sensory dorsal horn versus motor ventral horn distinction.

1793889229459.Text: No corno anterior, motoneurônios para {{c2::flexores}} ficam mais {{c1::dorsalmente}}.
1793889229459.Extra: This dorsoventral pattern is internal to the motor anterior horn. It complements the medial axial versus lateral distal organization.

1793889229460.Text: A afasia de Broca caracteriza-se por fala {{c1::não fluente}}.
1793889229460.Extra: A lesion of the dominant inferior frontal language region can impair speech production. The historical case illustrates anatomical localization within a larger language network.

1793889229461.Text: O transporte axonal utiliza {{c1::microtúbulos}} como trilhos intracelulares.
1793889229461.Extra: Motor proteins carry cargo along the axon. Anterograde transport proceeds toward terminals, whereas retrograde transport returns toward the soma.

1793889229462.Text: No transporte axonal, {{c1::anterógrado}} leva do soma ao terminal e {{c1::retrógrado}} faz o caminho inverso.
1793889229462.Extra: Anterograde labeling reveals projection targets, whereas retrograde labeling identifies neurons that project to the injection site. Interpretation depends on the tracer and its uptake properties.

1793889229463.Text: Em qual plano anatômico estão os dois cortes da figura? {{c1::Sagital}}
1793889229463.Extra: A sagittal section separates left and right portions. Matching the brainstem, cerebellum and midline cerebral structures across both panels links the anatomical drawing to the structural MR image.

1793889229464.Text:
Rebater uma bola, contribuições da rede:
Ver a trajetória: córtex {{c1::visual::v…}}
Planejar a ação: córtex {{c1::pré-motor::p…}}
Comando voluntário: córtex {{c1::motor::m…}}
Coordenar o movimento: {{c1::cerebelo::c…}}
1793889229464.Extra: These contributions interact through connected circuits. Local specialization and distributed processing coexist; no single region performs the whole behavior alone.

1793889229465.Text: A {{c1::ressonância magnética funcional}} detecta alterações {{c2::hemodinâmicas}} associadas à atividade cerebral.
1793889229465.Extra: Task-related activation is inferred from changes linked to blood oxygenation. It complements structural anatomy and does not directly record neuronal action potentials or prove causation.

1792572870667.Extra: Sensory neurons carry information from receptors toward the CNS. The highlighted cell connects peripheral input with central processing.

1792572870668.Extra: Motor neurons carry output to effectors. Somatic lower motor neurons innervate skeletal muscle, converting neural commands into contraction.

1792572870666.Extra: The myelin sheath insulates the axon between nodes. This enables rapid saltatory conduction rather than continuous regeneration along the whole membrane.

1792588686960.Text: O sistema nervoso periférico é composto por todas as estruturas nervosas fora do {{c1::encéfalo}} e da {{c1::medula espinal}}
1792588686960.Extra: The CNS comprises brain and spinal cord. Peripheral nerves, ganglia and sensory or motor endings connect these central structures with the body.

1792588686968.Extra: These divisions have different cellular architectures and connections. The cerebral hemispheres belong to the cerebrum, while the brainstem continues into the spinal cord.

1792588686971.Extra: The midbrain lies above the pons, which lies above the medulla. The cerebellum attaches dorsally and is not a fourth part of the brainstem.

1792329944339.Extra: Somatic motor output reaches skeletal muscle. Visceral motor output instead targets smooth muscle, cardiac muscle and glands.

1792588686967.Text:
Via eferente visceral:
Pré-ganglionar: corpo no {{c1::sistema nervoso central}}
Sinapse no {{c1::gânglio autônomo}}
Pós-ganglionar: alcança o {{c1::órgão efetor}}
1792588686967.Extra: The autonomic pathway uses a peripheral ganglionic relay. Visceral sensory afferents carry information inward and are distinct from this motor output.

1792329941889.Text: Há {{c1::31}} pares de nervos espinais no total.
1792329941889.Extra: The spinal pairs comprise 8 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar, 5 sacral and 1 coccygeal pair. Cranial nerves are counted separately.

1792588686961.Extra: Sympathetic and parasympathetic outputs control visceral effectors. Enteric circuits in the gut wall also integrate locally and interact with both divisions.

1792588686964.Text:
Nervo espinal, união das raízes:
Raiz {{c2::anterior}}: axônios {{c1::eferentes}}
Raiz {{c2::posterior}}: axônios {{c1::aferentes}}
1792588686964.Extra: The dorsal root carries sensory input and bears the sensory ganglion. The ventral root carries motor output; their union forms a mixed spinal nerve.

1792265021996.Text: Os corpos dos neurônios sensitivos primários ficam nos {{c1::gânglios espinais}}.
1792265021996.Extra: Sensory neuron somata remain outside the spinal cord. Their central processes enter through the dorsal root and carry peripheral information into the CNS.

1792697128629.Text:
Destino dos ramos anteriores:
Pescoço: plexo {{c1::cervical::c…}}
Membro superior: plexo {{c1::braquial::b…}}
Membro inferior: plexo {{c1::lombossacral::l…}}
Parede torácica típica: nervos {{c1::intercostais::i…}}
1792697128629.Extra: Most thoracic ventral rami continue as intercostal nerves. Plexuses redistribute fibers among named peripheral nerves; dorsal rami do not form these limb plexuses.

1792572870664.Extra: A spinal nerve forms where dorsal sensory and ventral motor roots unite. Its branches therefore distribute both afferent and efferent fibers.

1792572870665.Extra: The spinal ganglion contains primary sensory neuron somata outside the spinal cord. Central processes enter through the dorsal root.

1792572870659.Extra: The encephalon includes cerebrum,cerebellum and brainstem. It is the cranial part of the CNS and continues into the spinal cord.

1792572870656.Extra: The cerebrum includes telencephalon and diencephalon. The cerebral hemispheres contain cortex,deep nuclei and connecting white matter.

1792572870672.Extra: The spinal cord connects central circuits with spinal nerves. Its central gray matter and peripheral white matter support integration and long-distance conduction.

1792244864867.Extra: The cerebral aqueduct, tectal colliculi and cerebral peduncles identify the midbrain. The image is shown without the answer labels on the front.
1792244864867.Pergunta: Qual nível do tronco encefálico está no corte?

1792244863743.Extra: The expanded ventral basis and dorsal fourth ventricle identify the pons. Transverse pontine fibers contribute to the large ventral profile.
1792244863743.Pergunta: Qual nível do tronco encefálico está no corte?

1792244863368.Extra: An open fourth ventricle and prominent inferior olivary nuclei distinguish this rostral medullary section. The closed caudal medulla instead surrounds a central canal.
1792244863368.Pergunta: Qual nível do tronco encefálico está no corte?

1792329455442.Text: Na medula espinal, a substância {{c1::cinzenta}} fica no centro.
1792329455442.Extra: The central gray matter contains local circuits and motor neuron somata. Peripheral white matter carries ascending and descending axons.

1792329455695.Text: Na medula espinal, a substância {{c1::branca}} fica na periferia.
1792329455695.Extra: The surrounding white matter is organized into columns containing tracts. This arrangement differs from the superficial gray cortex of the cerebrum and cerebellum.

1792329761664.Text: Na medula espinal, a proporção de substância branca aumenta no sentido {{c1::rostral}}.
1792329761664.Extra: More rostral levels contain more ascending axons collected from below and descending axons headed to lower levels. Consequently, the relative amount of white matter increases rostrally.

1792329455992.Text: O corno {{c1::anterior}} da medula contém os corpos dos motoneurônios somáticos.
1792329455992.Extra: These lower motor neurons send axons through ventral roots toward skeletal muscle. Dorsal gray matter instead receives and processes sensory input.

1792329760618.Text: No encéfalo, o trato {{c1::corticoespinal}} comanda movimentos voluntários de membros {{c2::contralaterais}}.
1792329760618.Extra: Most corticospinal fibers cross in the caudal medulla. Above that crossing a unilateral lesion affects the opposite side; below it, the lateral tract affects the same side.
